_about: Input of `behaviour import`, maintained by hand: which captures supply the values BDS itself uses for custom blocks and items that do not set a component. Never guess or hand-write a value: an entry names a direct BDS source and the capture that measured the value (`capture`, a path from the repository root: the value is that capture's default of the key, see `behaviour-probe`), or, for a source that has no capture file, a literal `value` and a `reference` naming the evidence. Without an entry the default of a key is unknown (Provenance.Source.UNKNOWN_DEFAULT): the selection box and the destroy time of a custom block that sets neither are not known yet. Entry: {"key": "block:friction", "source": "BDS_PROBE", "capture": "data/bds/1.26.63.1/behaviour-probe/capture.json"}.
